## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — defect fix

- [ ] `perf` — performance or scale

- [ ] `test` — tests only

## Risk and rollout

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and matches the approved scope.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior at the lowest reliable layer, and relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Contracts, migrations, generated files and documentation are synchronized.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in a browser, including affected interactions and layouts.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private data or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] Security-relevant changes follow the private reporting policy in SECURITY.md.
